item.title: Now
item.description: What I am focused on right now: agentic screening systems, LLM evals, and cloud infrastructure at NUSX Labs.

item.title: Supply Chain Hygiene for Claude Code Plugins
item.description: How to pin Claude Code plugins, GitHub Actions, and zsh plugins to verified commit SHAs, and automate update checks before anything lands in your dev environment.

item.title: OpenROAD MCP: Let AI Close Your Timing
item.description: OpenROAD MCP is a server that lets AI assistants like Claude Code talk directly to a live OpenROAD process, so timing analysis and constraint fixes happen in one conversation.

item.title: Building Robust AI Research Agents: A tale of five specialists
item.description: Four architectural iterations of building a deep research workflow for VCs, from a single agent to five specialized agents with hierarchical citations, MCP integration, and iterative refinement.

item.title: Multi-Agent Systems Are 23x Cheaper Than Deep Research Models with Higher Quality
item.description: A benchmark of an 11-agent hypothesis generation system against GPT-4o-mini with tools and o4-mini-deep-research across 5 scientific domains. The multi-agent system won or tied in all 5 at a fraction of the cost.

item.title: About
item.description: I'm an AI & Systems Engineer at NUSX Labs building production LLM systems, agents, evals, data platforms, and GCP infrastructure. Previously Founding Engineer at SoraNova, AI Engineer at Espressif Systems, and Graduate Research Assistant at NUS (IROS 2021 Best Paper Award).
